user.title: ConnectPro KVM
user.description: Choose the KVM's serial port. The integration automatically configures it for 115200 baud, 8 data bits, no parity, and 1 stop bit. Disable any existing serial sensor or application using this port before continuing.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure ConnectPro KVM
reconfigure.description: Change the serial port or device name. The integration configures the port automatically and keeps the existing entities.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to open and configure this serial port. Check the device path and permissions, and stop other applications using the port.
error.invalid_device: Enter or select a serial device path.

abort.already_configured: This serial port is already configured.

send_command.name: Send command
send_command.description: Send one printable ASCII command to the selected KVM. A CRLF terminator is added automatically. Use this for commands whose behavior you have confirmed for your device.

device_id.name: KVM
device_id.description: The ConnectPro KVM device to send the command to.

command.name: Command
command.description: Command text, preserving case and without line endings. For example: Ch2.
